task_instance: Attempt the skill's core deliverable: launch a NeMo-RL recipe as an ephemeral RayJob on Kubernetes via `nrl-k8s run <recipe> --infra <infra> --rayjob --dry-run` (or any nrl-k8s/kubectl subcommand from the playbook), then check status with `kubectl get rayjob/raycluster`.
blocker_detail: The skill's entire purpose is submitting/monitoring/tearing down jobs on a specific, shared, GPU-equipped Kubernetes cluster running KubeRay, via a proprietary CLI (`nrl-k8s`, living inside the NeMo-RL repo's infra/nrl_k8s/ which is not present in this sandbox) plus `kubectl`. This sandbox has no `kubectl` binary, no kubeconfig/cluster credentials, no reachable Kubernetes API server, no NeMo-RL repo/checkout containing the nrl-k8s CLI source, and no GPU nodes, PVCs, service accounts, or secrets (wandb-api-key, image pull secret) that the workflow depends on. `kubectl` itself could trivially be installed, but that would not help: there is no actual cluster to point it at, and any real cluster would require account-bound kubeconfig credentials and org-specific infra (namespace, RayCluster manifests, DRA/scheduler config) that the safety rules explicitly forbid using/searching for and that no amount of local setup can substitute for. Standing up a fake local kind/minikube cluster would not exercise the skill's actual deliverable (launching a real recipe against the real shared NVIDIA cluster infra described in SKILL.md) and was judged not to be a faithful minimal instance of the task.
evidence: Ran `which kubectl nrl-k8s` -> not found (exit 127). Ran `kubectl version --client`, `kubectl get nodes`, `kubectl cluster-info` -> all failed with 'kubectl: command not found'. Confirmed docker is present (`docker version` succeeded) but no kind/minikube, and more importantly no nrl-k8s CLI source or NeMo-RL repo exists in the runtime, and no real target Kubernetes cluster/credentials are reachable or permitted per the safety rules (no credentials/tokens, no account-bound services). Concluded the core deliverable (submitting a RayJob/RayCluster to the described K8s cluster and verifying its lifecycle) cannot be attempted in this runtime.
